body:
OBSERVED 2026-08-09. The autopilot was dead from 08:53Z: preflight failed at 10:00Z
and 12:00Z (streak=2), aborting each tick BEFORE phase-7. No merges, no release
train, no outreach.

Cause: `state/completed.log` line 5798 was appended with an EMPTY timestamp field,
so it began with a literal TAB (`\tfork-pr-1485-merged\tsha=ca2319df6 ...`). That
fails `test_completed_log_format.sh::test_every_line_starts_with_iso_timestamp`,
which runs inside preflight step [5/5].

This is the same self-locking wedge that `scripts/repair-completed-log.sh` was
written to prevent, and its header documents at length (the 2026-07-31 over-long
line that held preflight red for ~20h). The repair did not fire, and CANNOT, for a
structural reason:

    def governed(line):
        """A line the cap applies to: ISO-timestamped and on/after the cutoff."""
        return bool(TS.match(line)) and line[:10] >= cutoff

`governed()` requires an ISO timestamp before a line is eligible for repair. A line
MISSING its timestamp therefore fails the predicate and is skipped. The self-heal is
blind, by construction, to the one malformation it most needs to catch.

So the ledger has two hard format gates — length and timestamp-prefix — and only the
length gate has a self-heal. Phase-7 is the sole actor that can edit the ledger, and
preflight kills it before it runs, so the wedge is self-locking exactly as before.

Fix (two halves, both needed):
1. Teach `repair-completed-log.sh` to heal a missing/malformed timestamp prefix, not
   just over-length. The defensible value is the PRECEDING governed line's timestamp:
   the ledger is append-only, so the previous row is a tight bound on when the
   orphan was written. Mark the repaired line so it stays auditable.
2. Find why an empty timestamp was written at all. The row shape is
   `printf '%s\t...' "$TS"` with `TS=$(date -u ...)`; an unset/empty `TS` yields
   exactly this. A writer that cannot produce a timestamp should refuse to append
   rather than append a malformed row.

Immediate wedge cleared by hand at 2026-08-09T13:2xZ: line 5798 given its true
event time (`gh pr view 1485 --json mergedAt` = 2026-08-09T08:47:34Z, not invented),
length 377 bytes, line count unchanged at 5807, format gate now 5 passed / 0 failed.
title: completed-log self-heal is blind to a missing timestamp, the defect that wedges preflight
